data.name: Gafoor
data.gender_notes: Gafoor is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gives, shows kindness and is generous. The name Gafoor carries the meaning “Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Gafoor usually hope their child will grow to embody generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Allah, signifying the one who is the provider and the bestower.
data.etymology: Gafoor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gafoor total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
